verdict.rationale: First-party docs show the API converts PDFs and other documents into Markdown, HTML, JSON, or chunks via a /convert endpoint. However, nothing in the pack addresses the hard parts of this story: multi-column layouts, header/footer handling, footnotes, or correct reading order. Missing for 10: documented multi-column reading-order handling, header/footer detection or removal, footnote handling, accuracy benchmarks, independent or hands-on corroboration of parse quality on complex PDFs.
